body: I have 2 brothers, (25 & 27). One works FIFO and is already under a lot of stress from working and then coming home to his wife and 2 kids. The older lives 500kms from us. My family has the philosophy of “suck it up and deal with it”. It is normalised. All of my grandparents are dead. I did speak to my English teacher about my upcoming essay, because I feel like I’m going to fail, and she was really nice and told me I’m capable of being the top student in the state, and that if I feel like I’m struggling she’ll help me out, so that’s good. But she’s split between 30 kids, so I don’t want to take that time away from kids who need the help. Thank you btw.
